output.title: Helm Chart nodeSelector quoting may affect this deployment
output.content: This environment deploys cert-manager via Helm (Flux HelmRelease, ArgoCD Application, and Helmfile are all active). The change quotes nodeSelector values in the Helm Chart template, which will be rendered during your v1.18.0 upgrade. Inspect whether you set custom nodeSelector values in your Helm values; if unquoted values were previously causing pod scheduling issues, this fix may change scheduling behavior. Check your Helm values override files for any nodeSelector configuration under cert-manager deployments.
